notes.title: Jungle Jinx — First Look and Our Plans
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, friends![/p][p]We’re excited to introduce our new project — [b]Jungle Jinx[/b], an arcade adventure set in the heart of the jungle.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703870/f1cf4e350f5973012a0fced5455c656ec449c4bf.png"][/img][/p][p]In this game you will:[/p][list][*][p]Run through ancient ruins, dodging traps and a giant rolling boulder.[/p][/*][*][p]Collect artifacts and upgrade your expedition camp.[/p][/*][*][p]Level up characters and unlock new abilities.[/p][/*][/list][p]This is our very first post, and we’d like to share our plans:
[b]🎉 We are preparing for the Steam Festival, which will take place this October![/b][/p][p][b]Multi-platform approach.[/b] Jungle Jinx is being developed for PC, consoles, and mobile devices. We plan to synchronize progress across platforms, allowing players to continue building their balance and progress seamlessly.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45703870/5ab092030d5544b7c742e21e6f5fab11552de41c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Different versions, different experiences:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Mobile:[/b] a fast-paced runner with character, weapon, and camp customization.[/p][/*][*][p][b]PC & Consoles:[/b] a story campaign with an isometric open world, plus mini-games (including the runner mode).[/p][/*][/list][p]The console version is currently in pre-production, so we can’t reveal too much yet. However, the [b]runner mode[/b] will soon be available on Steam for testing. We’ll adjust mechanics and features based on your feedback.[/p][p][b]What’s new in development?[/b][/p][list][*][p]We’re adding a destruction system — it looks dynamic and explosive![/p][/*][*][p]We’re introducing new ranged weapons, and we can’t wait to show you.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ll keep posting dev updates like this, so you can follow our journey.
[b]Share your questions and feedback in the comments — we value your opinion![/b][/p]
